title: Mechanistic insights into CO2-driven hydration of propargylic alcohols catalyzed by oxometallate ionic liquids
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12246-12255
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00803H, Paper

Neveen I. Atallah, Mohamed E. El-Khouly, Ahmed Abdelmoneim, Kei Ohkubo, Morad M. El-Hendawy
A DFT mechanistic study reveals how oxomolybdate-based ionic liquids promote CO2-assisted hydration of propargylic alcohols and how subtle metal-centred effects govern key steps in the catalytic pathway.
